authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.5: "For xs:double and xs:float, negative zero is taken as negative, positive zero as positive." Expectation taken from the W3C QT3 test suite, fn/format-number.xml numberformat322, format-number(-0.0e0, '0.0e0') = "-0.0e0". jsonata-js cannot answer this one at all: its $formatNumber loops forever on an exponent picture whose value is not positive.
